items: the reading organs: apollo · thea · hora · gary · martial · territory · output-holograph

the mouth kernel (the draw entry penelope directs)

the gates · the consensus · the falsifier → penelope's consensus-gate, the bow
the refusal · the honesty floor · falsify-or-die → penelope (already hers)
the scars (the record of every voyage) → her weft (already hers)

items: the archons' names (kleeneUp · Kelsen · Solon · Nagarjuna) → presented through the apps
"the reader that wanted a mark" → the person's voice, spoken at the surface
the answering · the chat · the interaction → eochat · the gym · the TUI
the mark (identity by consequence, the fold held at a point) → the app that holds it

named-gaps.note: the running resolver/cube still closes at 27; reSeed (REC on the axes) is constitutional, not operational. Named, not silent — the escape hatch stays unwired until the closure is actually open (2026-10-01, swarm attack 4).
named-gaps.falsifier: a reSeed that fires without an external witness, or a closure-at-3 reported as open while the running cube still hard-codes 27, contradicts this.

named-gaps.note: the 27/axes were recovered from human verb embeddings (a posteriori); the khora discloses the birth certificate (khora/H/H.mjs PROVENANCE) and never dresses them as a priori. The desert is a finding about languages, never machines.
named-gaps.falsifier: a claim that calls the 27 'a priori', or a run that under-attends where the prior is poor and reports the poverty as the machine's, contradicts this.

falsifyingControl: a part that migrates twice, a surface that re-implements a seam instead of delegating, or the khora accumulating a record, a judgment, a name, or a want contradicts this ledger.
